items.text: महातपा उवाच पूर्वमासीन्महादैत्यो बलवानन्धको भुवि स देवान्वशमानिन्ये ब्रह्मणो वरदर्पितः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: तेनात्मवान् सुराः सर्वे त्याजिता मेरुपर्वतम् ब्रह्माणं शरणं जग्मुरन्धकस्य भयार्दिताः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: तानागतांस्तदा ब्रह्मा उवाच सुरसत्तमान् किमागमनकृत्यं वो देवा ब्रूत किमास्यते
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: देवा ऊचुः अन्धकेनार्दिताः सर्वे वयं देवा जगत्पते त्राहि सर्वांश्चतुर्वक्त्र पितामह नमोऽस्तु ते
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: ब्रह्मोवाच अन्धकान्नैव शक्तोऽहं त्रातुं वै सुरसत्तमाः भवं शर्वं महादेवं व्रजाम शरणार्थिनः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: किंतु पूर्वं मया दत्तो वरस्तस्य सुरोत्तमाः अवध्यस्त्वं हि भविता न शरीरं स्पृशेन्महीम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: तस्यैवं बलिनस्त्वेको हन्ता रुद्रः परंतपः तत्र गच्छामहे सर्वे कैलासनिलयं प्रभुम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: एवमुक्त्वा ययौ ब्रह्मा सदेवो भवसन्निधौ तस्य संदर्शनाद्रुद्रः प्रत्युत्थानादिकाः क्रियाः कृत्वाभ्युवाच देवेशो ब्रह्माणं भुवनेश्वरम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: शंभुरुवाच किं कार्यं देवताः सर्वा आगता मम सन्निधौ येनाहं तत्करोम्याशु आज्ञा कार्या हि सत्वरम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: देवा ऊचुः रक्षस्व देव बलिनस्त्वन्धकाद्दुष्टचेतसः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: यावदेवं सुरा सर्वे शंसन्ति परमेष्ठिनः तावत्सैन्येन महता तत्रैवान्धक आययौ
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: बलेन चतुरङ्गेण हन्तुकामो भवं मृधे तस्य भार्यां गिरिसुतां हर्तुमिच्छन् ससाधनः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: तं दृष्ट्वा सहसायान्तं देवशक्रप्रहारिणम् संनह्य सहसा देवा रुद्रस्यानुचरा भवन्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: रुद्रोऽपि वासुकिं ध्यात्वा तक्षकं च धनंजयम् वलयं कटिसूत्रं च चकार परमेश्वरः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: नीलनामा च दैत्येन्द्रो हस्ती भूत्वा भवान्तिकमागतस्त्वरितः शक्रहस्तीवोद्धतरूपवान्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: स ज्ञातो नन्दिना दैत्यो वीरभद्राय दर्शितः वीरभद्रोऽपि सिंहेन रूपेणाहत्य च द्रुतम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: तस्य कृत्तिं विदार्याशु करिणस्त्वञ्जनप्रभाम् रुद्रायार्पितवान् सोऽपि तमेवाम्बरमाकरोत्ततः प्रभृति रुद्रोऽपि गजचर्मपटो ऽभवत्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: गजचर्मपटो भूत्वा भुजंगाभरणोज्ज्वलः आदाय त्रिशिखं भीमं सगणोऽन्धकमन्वयात्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: ततः प्रवृत्ते युद्धे च देवदानवयोर्महत् इन्द्राद्या लोकपालास्तु स्कन्दः सेनापतिस्तथा सर्वे देवगणाश्चान्ये युयुधुः समरे तदा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: तं दृष्ट्वा नारदो युद्धं ययौ नारायणं प्रति शशंस च महद्युद्धं कैलासे दानवैः सह
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: तच्छ्रुत्वा चक्रमादाय गरुडस्थो जनार्दनः तमेवं देशमागम्य युयुधे दानवैः सह
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: आगत्य च ततो देवा हरिणाप्यायिता रणे विषण्णवदनाः सर्वे पलायनपरा भवन्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: तत्र भग्नेषु देवेषु स्वयं रुद्रोऽन्धकं ययौ तत्र तेन महद्युद्धमभवल्लोमहर्षणम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: तत्र देवो ऽप्यसौ दैत्यं त्रिशूलेनाहनद्भृशम् तस्याहतस्य यद्रक्तमपतद्भूतले किल तत्रान्धका असंख्याता बभूवुरपरे भृशम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: तद्दृष्ट्वा महदाश्चर्यं रुद्रः शूलेऽन्धकं मृधे गृहीत्वा त्रिशिखाग्रेण ननर्त परमेश्वरः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: इतरे ऽप्यन्धकाः सर्वे चक्रेण परमेष्ठिना नारायणेन निहतास्तत्र येऽन्ये समुत्थिताः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: असृग्धारातुषारैस्तु शूलप्रोतस्य चासकृत् अनारतं समुत्तस्थुस्ततो रुद्रो रुषान्वितः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: तस्य क्रोधेन महता मुखाज्ज्वाला विनिर्ययौ तद्रूपधारिणी देवी यां तां योगेश्वरीं विदुः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: स्वरूपधारिणी चान्या विष्णुनापि विनिर्मिता ब्रह्मणा कार्त्तिकेयेन इन्द्रेण च यमेन च वराहेण च देवेन विष्णुना परमेष्ठिना
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: पातालोद्धरणं रूपं तस्या देव्या विनिर्ममे माहेश्वरी च राजेन्द्र इत्येता अष्टमातरः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: कारणं तानि यत्प्रोक्तं क्षेत्रज्ञेनावधारणम् शरीराद्देवतानां तु तदिदं कीर्तितं मया
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: कामः क्रोधस्तथा लोभो मदो मोहोऽथ पञ्चमः मात्सर्यं षष्ठमित्याहुः पैशुन्यं सप्तमं तथा असूया चाष्टमी ज्ञेया इत्येता अष्टमातरः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: कामं योगेश्वरीं विद्धि क्रोधो माहेश्वरीं तथा लोभस्तु वैष्णवी प्रोक्ता ब्रह्माणी मद एव च
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: मोहः स्वयंभूः कौमारी मात्सर्यं चेन्द्रजं विदुः यमदण्डधरा देवी पैशुन्यं स्वयमेव च असूया च वराहाख्या इत्येताः परिकीर्तिताः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: कामादिगण एषोऽयं शरीरे परिकीर्तितः जग्राह मूर्तिं तु यथा तथा ते कीर्तितं मया
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: एताभिर्देवताभिश्च तस्य रक्तेऽतिशोषिते क्षयं गतासुरी माया स च सिद्धोऽन्धकोऽभवत् एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातमात्मविद्यामृतं मया
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: य एतच्छृणुयान्नित्यं मातॄणामुद्भवं शुभम् तस्य ताः सर्वतो रक्षां कुर्वन्त्यनुदिनं नृप
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: यश्चैतत्पठते जन्म मातॄणां पुरुषोत्तम स धन्यः सर्वदा लोके शिवलोकं च गच्छति
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: तासां च ब्रह्मणा दत्ता अष्टमी तिथिरुत्तमा एताः सम्पूजयेद्भक्त्या बिल्वाहारो नरः सदा तस्य ताः परितुष्टास्तु क्षेमारोग्यं ददन्ति च
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).
